film: One Model: a Blender 5 showcase on a generalized mid-rise
notes: Shot lengths are whole beats at 80 BPM (18 frames). The building is generalized: no address, sheet numbers, signage, neighbouring OSM massing or street names on screen.

movements.title: Ink
movements.picture: Black frame; the plan outlines of every level draw themselves in white, then rise into walls.
movements.proof: 1-ink-f020.png, 1-ink-f060.png (headless, needs EGL: Mesa locally, NVIDIA on RunPod)

movements.title: Assembly
movements.picture: The building assembles floor by floor; slabs settle, brick coursing climbs the piers.

movements.title: Light
movements.picture: Locked-off wide, dawn to blue hour; the sun tracks across, windows switch on one by one.

movements.title: Matter
movements.picture: 85 mm inserts at f/2: brick, walnut, glass edges, bevelled corners.

movements.title: X-ray
movements.picture: Walls dissolve into a gold section; light pulses through the risers to show flow.

movements.title: Truth
movements.picture: One dolly; the look changes mid-move: shaded, line drawing, clay, provenance colours.

movements.title: Release
movements.picture: Descent from the roof at dusk to the entry; end card.
